text.en: An interactive reference for exploring practical chord progressions by tonic and key context.
text.zhTW: 依主音與調性脈絡探索實用和弦進行的互動參考工具。

text.en: Chord Progressions builds diatonic harmony for selected major or minor contexts, renders practical progressions and chord shapes, offers listening and practice guidance, and connects chords to the dictionary.
text.zhTW: 和弦進行會為所選大調或小調脈絡建立順階和聲、渲染實用進行與和弦指型、提供聆聽及練習提示，並將和弦連到字典。

text.en: The implementation turns abstract key harmony into playable and audible progression examples.
text.zhTW: 從實作回溯可見，它將抽象調性和聲轉為可彈奏、可聆聽的進行範例。

text.en: Choose a tonic and mode, inspect generated progressions and shapes, hear accompaniment, save or export a useful progression, and open detailed chord references.
text.zhTW: 選擇主音與調式、查看產生的進行與指型、聆聽伴奏、儲存或匯出實用進行，並開啟詳細和弦參考。

text.en: Chord Progressions was part of the first site foundation under chords.html; the later chord-progressions.html route did not represent a new product launch.
text.zhTW: 和弦進行以 chords.html 路徑存在於最初網站基礎；後來改為 chord-progressions.html 並不代表新產品推出。

text.en: A public progression reference available from the initial site history.
text.zhTW: 自最初網站歷史即提供的公開和弦進行參考。

text.en: Its early role was to make progression examples discoverable alongside backing tracks.
text.zhTW: 從初始網站結構回溯，其早期角色是讓和弦進行範例可與伴奏音軌一同探索。

text.en: The current successor route retains a page heading, key selector, tonic choices, generated result regions, and related controls.
text.zhTW: 目前後繼路徑保留頁面標題、調性選擇器、主音選項、產生結果區與相關控制。

text.en: chord-progressions.html defines the explorer controls and render hosts under the shared bilingual site shell.
text.zhTW: chord-progressions.html 在共用雙語網站外殼中定義探索器控制與渲染容器。

text.en: scripts/chords.js builds major/minor diatonic chords, renders progressions and shapes, links dictionary symbols, supplies scale/practice advice, schedules audio, and handles saved/exported progressions.
text.zhTW: scripts/chords.js 建立大／小調順階和弦、渲染進行與指型、連結字典符號、提供音階／練習建議、安排音訊並處理儲存／匯出進行。

text.en: Key controls and generated progression cards use wider grids for comparison.
text.zhTW: 調性控制與產生的進行卡使用較寬網格以便比較。

text.en: The page's selector-to-results hierarchy preserves task order as grids reduce columns.
text.zhTW: 從版面回溯可見，當網格縮減欄數時，選擇器到結果的層級仍維持任務順序。

text.en: The shared July mobile polish stacks controls and progression content while retaining touch-sized actions.
text.zhTW: 7 月共用行動版改善會堆疊控制與進行內容，同時保留適合觸控的操作。

text.en: Chord Progressions entered history with the first site foundation.
text.zhTW: 和弦進行隨最初網站基礎進入歷史。

text.en: The repository reorganization established the current chord-progressions.html path without treating it as a new product.
text.zhTW: 儲存庫重整建立目前 chord-progressions.html 路徑，且未將它視為新產品。

text.en: Shared localization added Traditional Chinese to page chrome and dynamic content.
text.zhTW: 共用在地化為頁面介面與動態內容加入繁體中文。

text.en: Chord Progressions is a bilingual static-browser tool at /chord-progressions.html with key selection, generated harmony, shapes, playback, practical guidance, saving/export, and cross-links to Chord Dictionary.
text.zhTW: 和弦進行目前是 /chord-progressions.html 的雙語靜態瀏覽器工具，包含調性選擇、產生式和聲、指型、播放、實用提示、儲存／匯出及和弦字典交叉連結。

text.en: Stable product identity should survive route renames; history is clearer when a URL change is not misreported as a second launch.
text.zhTW: 穩定產品身分應跨越路徑更名；不把網址變更誤報成第二次推出，歷史會更清楚。

text.en: No original progression curriculum, user study, or design brief was found in the reviewed history.
text.zhTW: 在已檢視歷史中，未找到原始和弦進行課程、使用者研究或設計簡報。
